body: I saved the bottle for you because it smelled like the trial orchard after spraying. I poured out the glasses before the roadblock appeared.
title: The drink I poured away

body:
I put aside four glasses after the men came in. They said the others would be back for them and asked me to write the names on a napkin.

I watched them pour the drinks away when they thought I had gone. The glasses were washed and returned to the shelf, but they kept the napkin.

One of the four had borrowed my coat. I still have the claim ticket for it, and no one will tell me where to take it.
title: The drinks still owed
